verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਸਦਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gur chelaa chelaa guroo gur sikh sun gursikh sadhaavai|

en.bdb: Having listened to the teachings of the Guru the disciple and the Guru become one (in form and spirit).

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਣਾ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: eik man ik araadhanaa baahar jaa(n)dhaa varaj rahaavai|

en.bdb: He with single mind adores the one Lord and keeps his straying mind under control.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਖਸਮੈ ਦਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: hukamee ba(n)dhaa hoi kai khasamai dhaa bhaanaa tis bhaavai|

en.bdb: He becomes obedient servant of the lord and loves His will and command.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਰੀਦ ਸੋਇ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਗੋਰਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: muradhaa hoi mureedh soi ko viralaa gur gor samaavai|

en.bdb: Any rare Sikh becoming disciple be a dead person enters the guru-grave.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਪੈਰਾਂ ਉਪਰਿ ਸੀਸੁ ਧਰਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: pairee pai paakhaak hoi pairaa(n) upar sees dharaavai|

en.bdb: Falling on the feet and becoming dust of the feet, he reposes his head on the feet of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਆਪੁ ਹੋਇ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: aap gavaae aap hoi dhoojaa bhaau na nadharee aavai|

en.bdb: Becoming one with Him he loses his ego and now the sense of duality is nowhere visible with him.
Such an accomplishment is had only by Sikh of the Guru.
